The source snippet confirms: "BaseCommit != HEAD — hooks haven't reconciled/migrated yet" → warning "tracking diverged from current HEAD; HEAD links to checkpoint(s) ...". So it means the session's tracked base commit differs from current HEAD; the HEAD commit carries the Entire-Checkpoint trailer for that session, but the session tracking hasn't been reconciled to that commit yet. It's benign/informational — typically resolves on the next commit/checkpoint when hooks reconcile, or the session tracking just points at an older base.

Wait, but the JSON status showed session 01a133d7 branch "main" while the worktree is on feat/local-drafts. Actually it showed two sessions; 01a133d7 branch "main", status idle. The status output showed "started 3d ago" and the warning. So the session's tracking base commit was on main (3 days ago); since then, work happened on feat/local-drafts and HEAD moved to a0f3b2d which has the trailer for checkpoint 01M54WE9 (created today at 12:12 via manual commit). So the session's base commit != HEAD and HEAD contains checkpoint IDs → warning.
